issue.title: Rank saved placeholder tags by relation, recency, and frequency
issue.description: The `<` completion menu ranks saved placeholder tags by how strongly they relate to the prompt being written, how recently they were used, and how often they were used, and every saved row shows the same compact, colored signal the history-word menu already uses to explain its ordering.

issue.title: Shared ranking-signal rendering
issue.description: signals_core: extract the score meter, dominant-reason chip, age formatter, palette, and colored legend out of the history-word row module into a provider-neutral rendering module behind a structural signal protocol, leaving history-word output byte-identical.

issue.title: Placeholder context store
issue.description: store: grow the durable common-placeholder store to version 2 with per-entry context bags and corpus statistics, record that evidence on the submit and launch paths, read version 1 stores forward-compatibly, and backfill context once from prompt history.

issue.title: Relation, recency, and frequency scoring
issue.description: ranking: add the pure scoring engine that turns the placeholder context store plus the prompt being edited into ranked placeholders with per-signal contributions, a dominant reason, and the evidence each row displays.

issue.title: Warm cache, menu, and settings wiring
issue.description: wiring: hold the placeholder index in the app-global warm cache, feed ranked saved tags through the Rust completion engine and reattach their ranking evidence, keep Ctrl+D deletion instant, and add the two ranking settings.

issue.title: Ranking signals in the placeholder panel
issue.description: signals: render the score meter and dominant-reason chip on saved placeholder rows, align both source groups on one label column, add the combined border-subtitle legend with an explicit width ladder, and refresh the docs and PNG goldens.

VERIFIED BY READING THE CODE AND THE FIVE COMMITS, not just the phase notes:

- o8.1 (555eba0b1) `_ranking_signal_rows.py` owns the score meter, reason chip, age
  formatter, palette and `ranking_signal_legend()`/`ranking_label_width()` behind a
  structural protocol; `_history_word_rows.py` and
  `_prompt_input_bar_completion_panel_labels.py` import them. No second meter
  implementation exists anywhere in `src/` (the `▰`/`▱` glyphs appear only in that
  module).
- o8.2 (ded7f1a5f) `_STORE_VERSION = 2` with `_READABLE_STORE_VERSIONS = {1, 2}`,
  per-entry context bags plus `context_uses`, `prompt_count`/`context_frequency` corpus
  stats, deterministic bag and vocabulary trims that log when they bite, `_add_context`
  excludes an entry's own `<text>` token, `seed_common_placeholders_from_history()`
  upgrades a v1 file in place via `_merge_seed_into_store()` keeping `count`/`last_used`
  authoritative and re-reading under the lock, and `remove_common_placeholder()` leaves
  corpus stats intact.
- o8.3 (577986af5) `prompt_placeholder_ranking.py` implements 0.50/0.30/0.20 weights, a
  14-day half-life, capped lift `log2(lift)/log2(8)` times `hits/(hits+2)` shrinkage
  gated by `RELATION_MIN_PROMPTS = 8`, a deterministic `(-score, casefold, text)` sort,
  the memo on `CommonPlaceholderIndex._ranking_memo`, and fixed-width `last_used` parsing
  with an epoch-0 fallback and age clamping. `prompt_context_tokens()` is shared by
  recording and ranking, so evidence and queries cannot drift.
- o8.4 (68aaa6863) the warm cache holds a `CommonPlaceholderIndex` while
  `common_placeholders()` still returns `list[str] | None` derived alongside it;
  `forget_common_placeholder()` drops the entry from the warm index so Ctrl+D stays
  instant; `build_indexed_placeholder_completion_result()` ranks first, hands texts to
  the Rust engine, and reattaches `PlaceholderRankingMetadata` by exact text;
  `_placeholder_highlight.py` routes through it only when the app exposes an index; and
  `placeholder_ranking`/`placeholder_ranking_signals` land in settings parsing, the JSON
  schema and `default_config.yml` defaulting to smart/true.
- o8.5 (5abf9eb64) `append_placeholder_completion_row()` appends meter then chip and
  degrades chip-first-then-meter by width; `placeholder_label_width()` measures both
  source groups with badge cells so they share one column;
  `placeholder_completion_subtitle()` implements the four-rung ladder; `docs/ace.md` and
  `docs/configuration.md` document the signals, glyphs, degradation and both settings;
  the `placeholder_common_completion_panel_120x40.png` golden was regenerated.
- Plan boundaries honored: no `../sase-core` change was needed or made, and no feature
  flag was created (`sase flag list` shows only the two pre-existing unrelated flags),
  both exactly as the plan required.
